description: Offer campaigns across brands. With no companyRefs, `mode` is 'top': the offers running across every tracked brand (or one categoryId's brands) in the trailing window, sorted by how many ads carry them, how long they have run, or how deep the discount is. With companyRefs, `mode` is 'calendar': those brands' campaigns in a date window, side by side, for comparing promo timing. Either way offers carried by ads come first, each brand's offer appears once, and at most `limit` come back. Use it for 'what offers are working in this market' and 'when do these brands run sales'. Fields this workspace can't see come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic). When a list is capped, `planLimit` is set: `maxResults` is the cap, `hiddenResults` is how many matching rows were not returned, and there is no next page. Do not estimate omitted values. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

categoryId.description: Top offers only. Scope to one industry category's subtree, e.g. the user's brand's: a brand's `category.id` from sightglass_get_company, or an id from sightglass_get_rankings.

companyRefs.description: Company ids or slugs: returns the promo calendar for these brands. Omit for the top offers across every tracked brand.

days.description: Top offers only. Trailing window; defaults to 30.

from.description: Calendar only. YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to six weeks back

limit.description: Most results to return: 20 by default, up to 50. Ones carried by ads come first.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where a saved asset or new file lands. Its workspace's access applies.

sort.description: Top offers only. ads = most ads carrying it, running = longest running, depth = deepest discount.

to.description: Calendar only. YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to a week ahead

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's access applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_offers
title: Find offers across brands
